gmail.name: Gmail
gmail.description: Read, search, draft and send email

actions.title: Send Email
actions.description: Sends an email via Gmail API using the authenticated user's Google profile display name.

actions.title: Delete Draft
actions.description: Permanently deletes a specific Gmail draft using its ID with no recovery possible; verify the correct `draft_id` and obtain explicit user confirmation before calling.

actions.title: Delete message
actions.description: Permanently deletes a specific email message by its ID from a Gmail mailbox; for `user_id`, use 'me' for the authenticated user or an email address to which the authenticated user has delegated access.

actions.title: Fetch emails
actions.description: Fetches a list of email messages from a Gmail account, supporting filtering, pagination, and optional full content retrieval.

actions.title: Fetch message by message ID
actions.description: Fetches a specific email message by its ID, provided the `message_id` exists and is accessible to the authenticated `user_id`.

actions.title: Get Gmail attachment
actions.description: Retrieves a specific attachment by ID from a message in a user's Gmail mailbox, requiring valid message and attachment IDs.

actions.title: Move to Trash
actions.description: Moves an existing, non-deleted email message to the trash for the specified user.

actions.title: Reply to email thread
actions.description: Sends a reply within a specific Gmail thread using the original thread's subject; do not provide a custom subject as it will start a new conversation instead of replying in-thread.

actions.title: Search People
actions.description: Searches contacts by matching the query against names, nicknames, emails, phone numbers, and organizations, optionally including 'Other Contacts'.

actions.title: Send Draft
actions.description: Sends an existing draft email AS-IS to recipients already defined within the draft.

actions.title: Create email draft
actions.description: Creates a Gmail email draft.

actions.title: Patch Event
actions.description: Update specified fields of an existing event in a Google Calendar using patch semantics (array fields like `attendees` are fully replaced if provided); ensure the `calendar_id` and `event_id` are valid and the user has write access to the calendar.

actions.title: Create Event
actions.description: Creates an event in a selected calendar using start_datetime and either end_datetime or duration fields.

actions.title: Delete event
actions.description: Deletes a specified event by `event_id` from a Google Calendar (`calendar_id`); idempotent — a 404 for an already-deleted event is a no-op.

actions.title: Create a calendar
actions.description: Creates a new, empty Google Calendar with the specified title (summary).

actions.title: List Events
actions.description: Lists or incrementally synchronizes events from one calendar, defaulting to the connected user's primary calendar.

actions.title: Move Event
actions.description: Moves an event to another calendar, i.e., changes an event's organizer.

actions.title: Find event
actions.description: Finds events in a specified Google Calendar using text query, time ranges (event start/end, last modification), and event types.

actions.title: Query Calendar Availability
actions.description: Queries raw busy intervals for one or more calendars or groups over an exact time range.

actions.title: Patch Calendar
actions.description: Partially updates (PATCHes) an existing Google Calendar, modifying only the fields provided.

actions.title: Quick Add Event
actions.description: Parses natural language text to quickly create a basic Google Calendar event with its title, date, and time, suitable for simple scheduling; does not support direct attendee addition or recurring events, and `calendar_id` must be valid if not 'primary'.

actions.title: Remove attendee from event
actions.description: Removes an attendee from a specified event in a Google Calendar; the calendar and event must exist.

actions.title: Update Google event
actions.description: Updates an existing event in Google Calendar.

actions.title: Create Google Meet Space
actions.description: Creates a new Google Meet space with optional configuration.

actions.title: Get Meet details
actions.description: Retrieve details of a Google Meet space using its unique identifier.

actions.title: Get recordings by conference record ID
actions.description: Retrieves recordings from Google Meet for a given conference record ID.

actions.title: Update Google Meet Space
actions.description: Updates the settings of an existing Google Meet space.

actions.title: Get transcripts by conference record ID
actions.description: Retrieves all transcripts for a specific Google Meet conference using its conference_record_id.

actions.title: Add Sheet to Existing Spreadsheet
actions.description: Adds a new sheet to a spreadsheet.

actions.title: Append Dimension
actions.description: Tool to append new rows or columns to a sheet, increasing its size.

actions.title: Batch update spreadsheet (Deprecated)
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use GOOGLESHEETS_VALUES_UPDATE instead.

actions.title: Clear Basic Filter
actions.description: Tool to clear the basic filter from a sheet.

actions.title: Delete Dimension (Rows/Columns)
actions.description: Tool to delete specified rows or columns from a sheet in a Google Spreadsheet.

actions.title: Delete Sheet
actions.description: Tool to delete a sheet (worksheet) from a spreadsheet.

actions.title: Get Spreadsheet by Data Filter
actions.description: Returns the spreadsheet at the given ID, filtered by the specified data filters.

actions.title: Get spreadsheet info
actions.description: Retrieves metadata for a Google Spreadsheet using its ID.

actions.title: Insert Dimension in Google Sheet
actions.description: Tool to insert new rows or columns into a sheet at a specified location.

actions.title: Set Basic Filter
actions.description: Tool to set a basic filter on a sheet in a Google Spreadsheet.

actions.title: Copy Sheet to Another Spreadsheet
actions.description: Tool to copy a single sheet from a spreadsheet to another spreadsheet.

actions.title: Append Values to Spreadsheet
actions.description: Tool to append values to a spreadsheet.

actions.title: Batch Clear Spreadsheet Values
actions.description: Tool to clear one or more ranges of values from a spreadsheet.

actions.title: Batch Get Spreadsheet Values by Data Filter
actions.description: Tool to return one or more ranges of values from a spreadsheet that match the specified data filters.

actions.title: Aggregate Column Data
actions.description: Searches for rows where a specific column matches a value and performs mathematical operations on data from another column.

actions.title: Batch get spreadsheet
actions.description: Retrieves data from specified cell ranges in a Google Spreadsheet.

actions.title: Clear spreadsheet values
actions.description: Clears cell content (preserving formatting and notes) from a specified A1 notation range in a Google Spreadsheet; the range must correspond to an existing sheet and cells.

actions.title: Create a Google Sheet
actions.description: Creates a new Google Spreadsheet in Google Drive.

actions.title: Create spreadsheet column
actions.description: Creates a new column in a Google Spreadsheet.

actions.title: Create spreadsheet row
actions.description: Inserts a new, empty row into a specified sheet of a Google Spreadsheet at a given index, optionally inheriting formatting from the row above.

actions.title: Find worksheet by title (Deprecated)
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use GetSpreadsheetInfo instead.

actions.title: Format cell
actions.description: Applies text and background cell formatting to a specified range in a Google Sheets worksheet.

actions.title: Get sheet names
actions.description: Lists all worksheet names from a specified Google Spreadsheet (which must exist), useful for discovering sheets before further operations.

actions.title: Look up spreadsheet row
actions.description: Finds the first row in a Google Spreadsheet where a cell's entire content exactly matches the query string, searching within a specified A1 notation range or the first sheet by default.

actions.title: Search Spreadsheets
actions.description: Search for Google Spreadsheets using various filters including name, content, date ranges, and more.

actions.title: Create sheet from JSON
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use GOOGLESHEETS_CREATE_GOOGLE_SHEET1 + GOOGLESHEETS_UPDATE_VALUES_BATCH (or GOOGLESHEETS_VALUES_UPDATE / GOOGLESHEETS_SPREADSHEETS_VALUES_APPEND) instead.

actions.title: Copy Google Document
actions.description: Tool to create a copy of an existing Google Document.

actions.title: Create Footer
actions.description: Tool to create a new footer in a Google Document.

actions.title: Create Footnote
actions.description: Tool to create a new footnote in a Google Document.

actions.title: Create Header
actions.description: Tool to create a new header in a Google Document, optionally with text content.

actions.title: Create Named Range
actions.description: Tool to create a new named range in a Google Document.

actions.title: Create Paragraph Bullets
actions.description: Tool to add bullets to paragraphs within a specified range in a Google Document.

actions.title: Delete Content Range in Document
actions.description: Tool to delete a range of content from a Google Document.

actions.title: Delete Footer
actions.description: Tool to delete a footer from a Google Document.

actions.title: Delete Header
actions.description: Deletes the header from the specified section or the default header if no section is specified.

actions.title: Delete Named Range
actions.description: Tool to delete a named range from a Google Document.

actions.title: Delete Paragraph Bullets
actions.description: Tool to remove bullets from paragraphs within a specified range in a Google Document.

actions.title: Delete Table Column
actions.description: Tool to delete a column from a table in a Google Document.

actions.title: Delete Table Row
actions.description: Tool to delete a row from a table in a Google Document.

actions.title: Get Charts from Spreadsheet
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all charts from a specified Google Sheets spreadsheet.

actions.title: Insert Inline Image
actions.description: Tool to insert an image from a given URI at a specified location in a Google Document as an inline image.

actions.title: Insert Page Break
actions.description: Tool to insert a page break into a Google Document.

actions.title: Insert Table in Google Doc
actions.description: Tool to insert a table into a Google Document.

actions.title: Insert Table Column
actions.description: Tool to insert a new column into a table in a Google Document.

actions.title: Insert Text into Document
actions.description: Tool to insert a string of text at a specified location within a Google Document.

actions.title: Replace All Text in Document
actions.description: Tool to replace all occurrences of a specified text string with another text string throughout a Google Document.

actions.title: Replace Image in Document
actions.description: Tool to replace a specific image in a document with a new image from a URI.

actions.title: Unmerge Table Cells
actions.description: Tool to unmerge previously merged cells in a table.

actions.title: Update Document Style
actions.description: Tool to update the overall document style, such as page size, margins, and default text direction.

actions.title: Update Table Row Style
actions.description: Tool to update the style of a table row in a Google Document.

actions.title: Create a document
actions.description: Creates a new Google Docs document using the provided title as filename and inserts the initial text at the beginning if non-empty, returning the document's ID and metadata (excluding body content).

actions.title: Create Document Markdown
actions.description: Creates a new Google Docs document, optionally initializing it with a title and content provided as Markdown text.

actions.title: Get document by id
actions.description: Retrieves an existing Google Document by its ID; will error if the document is not found.

actions.title: Search Documents
actions.description: Search for Google Documents using various filters including name, content, date ranges, and more.

actions.title: Update Document Markdown
actions.description: Replaces the entire content of an existing Google Docs document with new Markdown text; requires edit permissions for the document.

actions.title: Update existing document
actions.description: Applies programmatic edits, such as text insertion, deletion, or formatting, to a specified Google Doc using the `batchUpdate` API method.

actions.title: Download Outlook attachment
actions.description: Downloads a specific file attachment from an email message in a Microsoft Outlook mailbox; the attachment must contain 'contentBytes' (binary data) and not be a link or embedded item.

actions.title: Create Calendar Event
actions.description: Creates a new Outlook calendar event, ensuring `start_datetime` is chronologically before `end_datetime`.

actions.title: Create contact
actions.description: Creates a new contact in a Microsoft Outlook user's contacts folder.

actions.title: Create email draft
actions.description: Creates a new Outlook email draft with subject, body, recipients, and an optional attachment.

actions.title: List Outlook contacts (Deprecated)
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use OUTLOOK_LIST_USER_CONTACTS instead.

actions.title: Get calendar event
actions.description: Retrieves the full details of a specific calendar event by its ID from a user's Outlook calendar, provided the event exists.

actions.title: List events
actions.description: Retrieves events from a user's Outlook calendar via Microsoft Graph API.

actions.title: List Messages
actions.description: List or query Outlook messages from one folder (Inbox by default) or mailbox-wide with folder='allfolders'.

actions.title: Reply to Email
actions.description: Sends a reply to an Outlook email message with optional HTML formatting, attachments, CC, and BCC recipients.

actions.title: Update email message
actions.description: Updates specified properties of an existing email message; `message_id` must identify a valid message within the specified `user_id`'s mailbox.

actions.title: Send email
actions.description: Sends an email with subject, body, recipients, and optional attachments via Microsoft Graph API.

actions.title: Create a draft reply
actions.description: Creates a draft reply in the specified user's Outlook mailbox to an existing message (identified by a valid `message_id`), optionally including a `comment` and CC/BCC recipients.

actions.title: Delete calendar event (Deprecated)
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use OUTLOOK_DELETE_CALENDAR_EVENT instead.

actions.title: Get email message
actions.description: Retrieves a specific email message by its ID from the specified user's Outlook mailbox.

actions.title: Get schedule
actions.description: Retrieves free/busy schedule information for specified email addresses within a defined time window.

actions.title: Search Outlook messages
actions.description: Search Outlook messages using powerful KQL syntax.

actions.title: Update calendar event
actions.description: Updates specified fields of an existing Outlook calendar event.

actions.title: Create online meeting
actions.description: Use to schedule a new standalone Microsoft Teams online meeting, i.e., one not linked to any calendar event.

actions.title: Create Chat
actions.description: Creates a new chat; if a 'oneOnOne' chat with the specified members already exists, its details are returned, while 'group' chats are always newly created.

actions.title: Get all chats
actions.description: Lists a specified user's Microsoft Teams chats, supporting filtering and property selection.

actions.title: Get all chat messages (Deprecated)
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use ListUserChatMessages instead.

actions.title: Create a channel
actions.description: (DEPRECATED: use `MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CREATE_CHANNEL`) Tool to create a new standard, private, or shared channel within a Microsoft Teams team.

actions.title: Get chat message
actions.description: Tool to get a specific chat message.

actions.title: List Teams
actions.description: Retrieves Microsoft Teams accessible by the authenticated user, allowing filtering, property selection, and pagination.

actions.title: List team channels
actions.description: Retrieves channels for a specified Microsoft Teams team ID (must be valid and for an existing team), with options to include shared channels, filter results, and select properties.

actions.title: List chat messages (Deprecated)
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use ListUserChatMessages instead.

actions.title: List People
actions.description: Retrieves a list of people relevant to a specified user from Microsoft Graph, noting the `search` parameter is only effective if `user_id` is 'me'.

actions.title: Send Channel Message
actions.description: Posts a new top-level message to a channel in Microsoft Teams (does NOT reply to an existing message).

actions.title: Send message to Teams chat
actions.description: Sends a non-empty message (text or HTML) to a specified, existing Microsoft Teams chat; content must be valid HTML if `content_type` is 'html'.

actions.title: Reply to Teams channel message
actions.description: (DEPRECATED: use `MICROSOFT_TEAMS_POST_MESSAGE_REPLY`) Sends a reply to an existing message, identified by `message_id`, within a specific `channel_id` of a given `team_id` in Microsoft Teams.

actions.title: List OneDrive items
actions.description: Retrieves one page of files and folders as `driveItem` resources from the root of a specified user's OneDrive.

actions.title: Search Items
actions.description: Search OneDrive for files and folders by keyword.

actions.title: Get Item Metadata
actions.description: Retrieves the metadata of a DriveItem by its unique ID.

actions.title: Create folder
actions.description: Creates a new folder in the user's OneDrive with configurable conflict behavior, optionally within a specified parent_folder (by ID or full path from root) which, if not the root, must exist and be accessible.

actions.title: Upload file
actions.description: Uploads a file to a specified OneDrive folder, automatically creating the destination folder if it doesn't exist, renaming on conflict, and supporting large files via chunking.

actions.title: Update File Content
actions.description: Tool to update an existing file's content in OneDrive.

actions.title: Download a file
actions.description: Downloads a file from a user's OneDrive using its item ID, which must refer to a file and not a folder.

actions.title: Copy Item
actions.description: Tool to copy a DriveItem (file or folder) to a new location asynchronously.

actions.title: Move Item
actions.description: Tool to move a file or folder to a new parent folder in OneDrive.

actions.title: Delete Item
actions.description: Tool to delete a DriveItem (file or folder) by its unique ID from the authenticated user's OneDrive.

actions.title: List Drives
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of Drive resources available to the authenticated user, or for a specific user, group, or site.

actions.title: Create Sharing Link
actions.description: Tool to create a sharing link for a DriveItem (file or folder) by its unique ID.

actions.title: Invite User to Drive Item
actions.description: Tool to invite users or grant permissions to a specific item in a OneDrive drive.

actions.title: Read Workbook Range
actions.description: Reads a range of cells from an Excel workbook worksheet stored in OneDrive or SharePoint using Microsoft Graph API.

actions.title: Update Workbook Range
actions.description: Updates a range in a workbook worksheet using Microsoft Graph API.

actions.title: Send message
actions.description: Posts a message to a Slack channel, DM, or private group.

actions.title: Update a Slack message
actions.description: Updates a Slack message by timestamp.

actions.title: Delete a message from a chat
actions.description: Deletes a message, identified by its channel ID and timestamp, from a Slack channel, private group, or direct message conversation; the authenticated user or bot must be the original poster.

actions.title: Schedule message
actions.description: Schedules a message to a Slack channel, DM, or private group for a future time (`post_at`), requiring `text`, `blocks`, or `attachments` for content; scheduling is limited to 120 days in advance.

actions.title: Add reaction to message
actions.description: Adds a specified emoji reaction to an existing message in a Slack channel, identified by its timestamp; does not remove or retrieve reactions.

actions.title: Create channel
actions.description: Initiates a public or private channel-based conversation in a Slack workspace.

actions.title: Search Issues Using JQL Enhanced (POST)

actions.description: Tool to create a new Confluence whiteboard.
